name: The Unbuilding Ruins
introDiscord:
Ruins assemble backward.

Broken walls leap upward, become whole, then dissolve into raw stone.

A staircase unbuilds itself directly after you climb it.
introTwitch:
Ruins assemble backward.

Broken walls leap upward, become whole, then dissolve into raw stone.

A staircase unbuilds itself directly after you climb it.

the-unbuilding-ruins-approach.prompt: Three impossible routes open across The Unbuilding Ruins.

left.message: A chest finishes constructing itself around Star Candies.

right.message: A Fae Stoneweaver pulls stones from a wall that has not been built yet.

forward.message: A ruined shelter briefly becomes whole around you.
forward.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

the-unbuilding-ruins-depths.prompt: Deeper within The Unbuilding Ruins, three paths bend through the unstable Nexus.

left.message:
A Stoneweaver dismantles the floor while fighting.

Bold strategy.

right.message:
A completed vault exists for twelve seconds.

Enough.

forward.message:
One Berry rests beneath Shizuki's note:

'Built chair.

Chair unbuilt itself.

Sat on floor.

Floor also left.

Bad architecture.'

the-unbuilding-ruins-threshold.prompt: Near Blueprint of Vanishing Stone, three final routes cross the edge of reality.

left.message: A completed sanctuary briefly restores you.
left.fullHpMessage: You leave the restorative untouched. You're already at full health.

right.message: A Stoneweaver assembles a weapon from a future wall.

forward.message: A coffer appears as surrounding stone vanishes.

boss-antechamber.name: Blueprint of Vanishing Stone
boss-antechamber.prompt: Blueprint of Vanishing Stone draws itself in glowing lines.

bossPromptDiscord:
Blueprint of Vanishing Stone draws itself in glowing lines.

A massive architect assembles from the plan.

Use /yes to enter or /no to wait for the building to
finish deciding whether it exists.
bossPromptTwitch:
Blueprint of Vanishing Stone draws itself in glowing lines.

A massive architect assembles from the plan.

Use !yes to enter or !no to wait for the building to
finish deciding whether it exists.
bossRetreatText: You withdraw from Blueprint of Vanishing Stone. The impossible guardian will wait.

boss.revealText:
The blueprint stands up.

Last Architect Construct reveals itself!

completionText:
The ruins stop rebuilding.

Shizuki's chair remains absent.

A tragedy.
